name: app_service
description: Manages a DuploCloud AI Helpdesk app service (Kubernetes Deployment).

attributes.name: workspace_id
attributes.description: ID of the workspace that owns this app service.

attributes.name: name
attributes.description: Name of the app service resource.

attributes.name: description
attributes.description: Optional description.

attributes.name: scope_ids
attributes.description: Scope IDs that link this app service to a cloud provider account.

attributes.name: resource_group_id
attributes.description: ID of the resource group (EKS cluster) this app service belongs to.

attributes.name: environment_id
attributes.description: ID of the environment that owns the resource group.

attributes.name: namespace_name
attributes.description: Kubernetes namespace the deployment is created in.

attributes.name: deployment_name
attributes.description: Name of the Kubernetes Deployment object (typically the same as name).

attributes.name: replicas
attributes.description: Number of pod replicas.

attributes.name: strategy_type
attributes.description: Deployment update strategy: RollingUpdate or Recreate.

attributes.name: service_account_name
attributes.description: Service account the pods run as.

attributes.name: match_labels
attributes.description: Deployment selector matchLabels. Must match pod_labels.

attributes.name: pod_labels
attributes.description: Labels applied to the pod template (must satisfy match_labels).

attributes.name: labels
attributes.description: Kubernetes labels applied to the Deployment object.

attributes.name: annotations
attributes.description: Kubernetes annotations applied to the Deployment object.

attributes.name: containers
attributes.description: Containers that make up the pod.

attributes.name: name
attributes.description: Container name.

attributes.name: image
attributes.description: Container image (e.g. nginx:1.27).

attributes.name: command
attributes.description: Entrypoint override.

attributes.name: args
attributes.description: Arguments to the entrypoint.

attributes.name: image_pull_policy
attributes.description: Image pull policy: Always, IfNotPresent, or Never.

attributes.name: working_dir
attributes.description: Container working directory.

attributes.name: ports
attributes.description: Ports the container exposes.

attributes.name: container_port
attributes.description: Port number the container listens on.

attributes.name: name
attributes.description: Named port.

attributes.name: protocol
attributes.description: Protocol: TCP, UDP, or SCTP.

attributes.name: env
attributes.description: Environment variables (literal values).

attributes.name: name
attributes.description: Variable name.

attributes.name: value
attributes.description: Variable value.

attributes.name: resources_limits
attributes.description: Resource limits, e.g. { cpu = "500m", memory = "512Mi" }.

attributes.name: resources_requests
attributes.description: Resource requests, e.g. { cpu = "250m", memory = "256Mi" }.

attributes.name: provisioner_type
attributes.description: Provisioner type: Cli, IacNativeTf, IacDuploTf, or DirectApiCall.

attributes.name: provisioner_version
attributes.description: Optional provisioner version.

attributes.name: status
attributes.description: Current provisioning status.

attributes.name: service_name
attributes.description: Name of the provisioned Service (if any).

attributes.name: ingress_name
attributes.description: Name of the provisioned Ingress (if any).

failureStates.WaitingForApproval: provisioning is waiting for manual approval, which Terraform cannot provide
